venue.description:
For all your nail, lash, brow and waxing needs in Heidelberg, look no further than Golden Nail Care. Centrally located on Burgundy Street, this lively salon is as fun as it is convenient.
 
Whether your nails are in dire need of a mani/pedi, or perhaps you are eager to try a new look with vibrant nail art; the fantastic team at Golden Nail Care will make you feel comfortable and relaxed while they work their magic on your nails.
 
The same goes for their exceptional lash and brow treatments and waxing services, all of which they use top-shelf products for – so you can rest assured your beauty is in good hands with Golden Nail Care in Heidelberg.
 
Do yourself a favour and book your appointment online today, with Bookwell.
